item.title: [HIRING] Founding n8n Builders for US Small-Business Client Work | Freelance, Remote
item.dc:creator: aidan_automatch
item.description:
Role: Founding n8n builder (independent freelance work, not employment)

Company: AutoMatch (https://useautomatch.com), a new marketplace that matches small businesses with AI and automation builders. I’m Aidan, the founder.

The work: Building and maintaining automations for US small businesses, such as missed-call handling, lead follow-up and appointment booking. Businesses describe the problem in plain English, and our match agent ranks builders on specialty, tools, budget and timeline. You can charge one-time, monthly, or both. Payments run through the platform, with funds held until the work is approved.

Requirements: Hands-on n8n experience, examples of client work, and comfort explaining automations to non-technical owners.

Location: Remote. Clients are in US time zones.

Good to know: We just launched and are recruiting our first builders, so project volume isn’t guaranteed. We take care of all the lead generation and client outreach for you, reaching out to business owners every day. Founding builder spots are still open, with free membership during launch.

How to apply: AutoMatch or email aidan@useautomatch.com with a link to your work.

item.title: [HIRING] Freelancer for Custom AI-Powered Marketing Attribution & Lead Automation Pipeline Project
item.dc:creator: Riena
item.description:
I work for the biggest business coaching company in Indonesia.
I need a freelancer who speaks Bahasa Indonesia fluently & live in the same time zone with Jakarta, Indonesia (GMT+7), to build one time project of an end-to-end marketing attribution & lead engine that includes:

  1. Direct API ingestion for Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube into BigQuery/Supabase via n8n.

  2. AI-powered schema standardization and lead scoring (Hot/Warm/Cold).

  3. Phone/email deduplication lookup & round-robin lead rotator.

  4. Multi-touch customer journey database logging touchpoints over time.

  5. Outbound WhatsApp integration via Mekari Qontak or WAHA HTTP API endpoints.

  6. Looker Studio dashboard displaying aggregated CPM, CTR, CPL, CPLPV, CPP, and ROAS.

    Project Brief: Multi-Channel Marketing Attribution & Automated Lead Engine

    1. Objective

    Build an automated data pipeline, lead deduplication engine, lead scoring, multi-touch journey tracker, and WhatsApp notification workflow using self-hosted n8n, an AI Agent node, a relational database (Google BigQuery or Supabase), and Looker Studio.

    2. Key Scope & Deliverables

    1. Ad Data Ingestion Pipeline (Bypassing Supermetrics):

      • Configure scheduled n8n workflows pulling spend, impressions, clicks, CPM, and CTR directly via platform REST APIs (Meta Insights, TikTok Marketing, LinkedIn Ads, YouTube Data API).

    2. AI Schema Standardization & Lead Scoring:

      • Implement an LLM API node (OpenAI/Claude) in n8n to unify ad metrics into a single database schema and parse UTM parameters.
      • Configure lead scoring rules to grade lead quality (Hot/Warm/Cold) based on platform origin, ad set metadata, and form values.

    3. Phone & Email Deduplication + Smart Rotator:

      • On incoming lead submission (formulir.id / web form):
        • Query database by phone_number and email.
        • IF lead exists: Route to existing assigned sales rep.
        • IF new lead: Assign to sales reps via weighted round-robin based on lead score.

    4. Multi-Touch Journey Logging:

      • Design an event-based database schema tracking interactions over time (e.g., Nov 2026 IG ad → Jan 2027 WA outreach → Feb 2027 LinkedIn purchase) to calculate true CPL, CPLPV, CPP, and ROAS.

    5. WhatsApp Messaging Integration:

      • Build outbound HTTP API triggers connecting n8n to Mekari Qontak API or self-hosted WAHA (WhatsApp HTTP API) for immediate auto-replies and automated broadcast sequences.

    6. Visualization Dashboard:

      • Connect BigQuery/Supabase to Google Looker Studio displaying unified top-of-funnel and bottom-of-funnel performance.

    3. Required Technical Stack

    • Orchestration: Self-hosted n8n (Docker container on VPS)

    • AI Node: OpenAI GPT-4o / Anthropic API

    • Database: Google BigQuery or Supabase

    • Dashboard: Google Looker Studio

    • WhatsApp API: Mekari Qontak Open API / WAHA (WhatsApp HTTP API)

      Could you share your estimated hours, scope, and availability for this project? Kindly contact me through email at oktarina.nurhayati@gratyo.id.

      Thank you

item.title: [HIRING] Agency Operations & AI Systems Builder | Remote, part-time
item.dc:creator: Alpenes_Kasap
item.description:
We’re hiring at Beyond Creator, Canada’s first AI-powered marketing agency, founded in Toronto. We produce 200+ pieces of content each month for restaurants and hospitality brands.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys understanding how a creative team works, keeping projects moving, and building practical tools that people actually use.

The work

  • Help keep priorities, deadlines and handoffs clear in Notion and Slack.
  • Build useful AI workflows with n8n, APIs and webhooks.
  • Write, debug and publish small applications.
  • Test the workflows, handle failures and document how they work.
  • Bring good visual judgment and an understanding of marketing or creative production.

This is an ongoing remote, part-time role, starting at about 15 hours per week, with room to grow as the collaboration develops. Applications are welcome from Canada, Türkiye and elsewhere. Clear English and some overlap with Toronto working hours matter. Turkish is a plus.

Show us something you built

A useful personal AI project counts. Please share the problem, what you personally built, a demo and a code sample or published app. We’d also like one example of a project you helped coordinate. A CV is optional.

Apply through our form:

Notion

Notion | Where teams and agents work together

Made in Notion, the connected workspace where AI agents and teams organize docs, projects and knowledge together.

If you have already completed this form for the role, there is no need to submit it again.

item.title: Looking for BD & Referral Partners — Remote, Commission-Based
item.dc:creator: yonder
item.description:
Hi everyone,

I’m looking for independent BD and referral partners for TokAtlas. We’ve built an AI API platform that gives customers access to multiple model providers through one account and API key.

This could be a fit if you already work with n8n consultants, automation agencies or software teams whose clients use AI APIs.

The work involves:

  • Introducing us to relevant decision-makers through your existing network.
  • Helping us understand their use cases, model requirements and API needs.
  • Working with our team to move suitable opportunities through evaluation and into paid usage.

Our technical team provides integration support and helps customers evaluate model options. We also support private deployments of open-source models for enterprise clients.

This is an independent, commission-based partnership. We’ll agree on the commission structure, referral attribution and payment terms before we start.

Experience in AI consulting, cloud services, developer tools or B2B sales would be useful. What matters most is having relevant customer relationships and being able to help move a conversation forward.

If you’re interested, send me a private message with a short introduction, the types of customers you work with, and a brief example of your sales or referral experience. Please also include your location or time zone so we can discuss how to work together.
